BiblicalUsage: Hadashah was a town in the low country of Judah, named once among the cities of the tribe — Zenan, Hadashah, and Migdal-gad. It is one of the many small towns the book of Joshua records without another word.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the small towns are kept for a reason: Judah's inheritance was measured town by town, and none was left off the list.
